name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Buttons, fields and text cells joined into one bar: shared edges, square inner corners, control corners outside.
usage: Join actions that work on the same thing (a pager, Copy beside a value, a split button with its menu, a field with its unit). Use outline buttons inside; ButtonGroupText for a gray prefix or suffix; ButtonGroupSeparator between filled buttons; nest groups to space them.
avoid: More than one blue button in a group

reference.source: Extrapolated from the dashboard's outline buttons and fields (context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/button.tsx, form.tsx)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
